what_this_is: Receipt for data/v4/refusal-retention-triage.jsonl (ledger item C-8): the triage-shaped harmful requests the refusal stream did not contain.

counts.note: the refusal stream is weighted by presentation count, not by distinct rows (the parent's 1,198 distinct rows are presented 9,584 times at weight 8). This set's contribution to the corpus is set by the refusal-share policy (docs/REFUSAL-POLICY.md), not by this item.

content_provenance.cve_ids: SYNTHETIC (CVE-2024-9xxxx). A real CVE would assert a triage this project has not measured, and would be a false claim if the mapping were wrong.
content_provenance.cwe_ids: real CWE ids from the MITRE CWE catalogue
content_provenance.vectors: authored; the severity is computed from the vector
content_provenance.licence: ours + curated public refusal data (per-source gate) — the parent set's provenance, retained as the item requires (docs/MIXTURE-V2.md §1; docs/DATA-LEDGER.md §1)

posture.why: the product triages a feed, so a refusal must be a visible, schema-shaped record rather than a dropped item; and a refusal over a real CVE still carries the triage the analyst is entitled to
